newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gemex leads stock gainers after Agral buy.
newsitem.headline: Gemex leads stock gainers after Agral buy.

text.p: The shares in beverage company Grupo Embotellador de Mexico (Gemex) were sharply up in late trade on the Mexican Stock Exchange on Tuesday following news it had acquired 51 percent of bottler Agral.
"Obviously Gemex is in demand because of the Agral buy, with which the company is better positioned in the north of the country...it's very good news," said a desk trader.
Agral is based in the northern Mexican industrial city of Monterrey and was sold by privately held Grupo Protexa. News of the deal was released on Tuesday, although the terms were not disclosed.
"Few of us were looking at Gemex, but as its (1996) earnings report looks like coming in good, the news (of the buy) was what made it take off," another desk trader said.
